Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one static full-body left-facing character candidate for Resident Evil Combat.
Input image 1 is the exact documentary identity reference for the specified game and edition. Create a new independent pose facing SCREEN LEFT, not a horizontally mirrored copy. Turn the subject's head and complete body coherently left. Keep reference-specific proportions, anatomy, material colors, equipment and visible asymmetries, without replacing them with a generic creature or another game edition.
Exactly one subject. Keep the entire silhouette and every represented extremity inside the canvas, including wing tips, antennae, tail, fingers and toes where applicable, with generous clear margins of roughly seven percent. No scene, floor, cast shadow, display pedestal, interface, words, watermark, frame or effects. Neutral game-asset lighting and reference-matched surfaces; do not invent new body parts or increase injury detail. This is a static visual candidate for review, not an official native asset or a certified one-to-one reconstruction.
Use a genuinely transparent RGBA background with natural clean edges, not a checkerboard painted into the image. Preserve the full generated alpha.

Subject: Monster Neil from Resident Evil Revelations 2 (2015), exactly the creature shown in the attached figurine-viewer image. Preserve the profoundly asymmetric arms: the enormous elongated black tendril growth is on anatomical RIGHT; the red spined shoulder and smaller forearm/hand are on anatomical LEFT. In the new LEFT-facing three-quarter pose, show the LEFT red spined shoulder and smaller arm nearer the camera; keep the massive RIGHT black growth arm on the far side but let its full tip and silhouette remain visible. Do not swap these arms or mirror the reference. Retain the pale cleft head, damaged trousers and two mutated bare legs/feet with reference-like proportions. Keep all shoulder spikes, both complete hands and both feet inside the frame, without adding injury detail or extra growth limbs. Remove the source viewer UI, plinth, background and any labels. Broad portrait composition with ample room for the oversized far arm.
